description: Every object an address owns, page by page, out of the node's own owner index. Narrow it with type: a bare Move type such as 0x2::coin::Coin matches any type parameter, while a fully applied one matches only that instantiation. A page holds 50 entries by default and 200 at most; when the node holds more, an opaque cursor comes back and expandResult returns the following page in this same shape. Reads only.

pageSize.description: How many objects to return (default 50, max 200). The tail is reachable through the returned cursor.

type.description: Move type filter, with or without its type parameters. Omit to list every owned object.

name: suiListOwnedObjects
title: Objects owned by a Sui address
